scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard anything back yet. Can you tell me if there's an update?
dialogue.agent: Your FHA loan application for refinancing has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh, no. That's disappointing. Can you tell me why it was denied?
dialogue.agent: The primary reason for the denial is that the credit application was incomplete.

dialogue.user: I see. That's concerning. Since the application was denied, are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on it? And can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio was in relation to this decision?
dialogue.agent: This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. The debt-to-income ratio is not applicable in this case as the application was denied.

dialogue.user: That's good to know there are no high-cost or negative amortization flags. But it's still not clear why it was denied if the credit application was incomplete. Was there something specific missing from my credit information? Also, has this loan application been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record indicates the credit application was incomplete. We do not have information on specific missing items. As the loan application was denied, it has not been sold or transferred to another institution.

dialogue.user: This is quite frustrating. I felt I provided all the necessary documentation. Is there anyone I can speak to who might have more details about what was considered "incomplete" about my credit application? I'm trying to understand what went wrong here. Also, what was the loan term on my application?
dialogue.agent: I understand this is frustrating. Unfortunately, the loan record does not contain further details on what specifically made the credit application incomplete. The loan term for your application was 360 months.

dialogue.user:
I appreciate you confirming the loan term. It's just a shame that I can't get more clarity on the denial reason. Since I can't get any more information, I think I have what I need for now.

<Dissatisfied> The agent was polite, but I still don't fully understand why my application was denied, and I feel like I'm hitting a dead end.
